description: List the languages this workspace writes product content in: the base language (the text stored on products, categories and brands themselves), the extra languages the owner added, and the offered set — every language the CRM shows as a translation tab. Each entry is an ISO 639-1 code with its English name. Read-only. Call it BEFORE writing any translation (upsert_product_translation, upsert_category_translation, upsert_brand_translation) and write only offered languages; never write the base language as a translation.
name: list_content_locales
title: List content languages
